question: Who among the following is primarily regarded as a maestro of Hindustani classical music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bade Ghulam Ali Khan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bade Ghulam Ali Khan** is considered one of the greatest maestros of Hindustani classical music.
 
• He was a prominent figure in the **Patiala Gharana**, known for his powerful voice and intricate renditions.
 
• Bade Ghulam Ali Khan's contributions to Hindustani classical music have left a lasting legacy and continue to inspire many musicians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hindustani classical music** is a tradition that dates back thousands of years and is deeply rooted in Indian culture.
 
• The music is characterized by its use of ragas (melodic frameworks) and talas (rhythmic cycles).
 
• Other notable figures in Hindustani classical music include **Ustad Amir Khan, Pandit Bhimsen Joshi,** and **Ustad Rashid Khan**.
 
• The Patiala Gharana, to which Bade Ghulam Ali Khan belonged, is known for its intricate and elaborate vocal techniques.
 
• His famous renditions include ragas like **Malkauns** and **Darbarikanada**.
